# Configuration of a branch preview, loaded with MISE_ENV=preview.

[env]
EGR_BUILD_MODE = "staging"
EGR_BUCKET = "egr-assets-staging"

# The bucket and the credentials that may write to it belong to the same
# environment, so selecting one selects the other. See fnox.toml.
FNOX_PROFILE = "staging"

VITE_BASE_PATH = "https://egr-assets-staging.object.storage.eu01.onstackit.cloud/preview/{{ env.PREVIEW_NAME }}/"
VITE_FEATURE_FLAG_POSTHOG_TESTING = "true"
VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN = "phc_rUbW5TOq15FHTu5PoKh3g4uCJNNN7MvHu2WJPUIjEpa"
VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST = "https://ph-proxy.dev.tech.digitalservice.dev"
===
# Configuration of the STACKIT staging environment, loaded with MISE_ENV=staging.

[env]
EGR_BUILD_MODE = "staging"
EGR_BUCKET = "egr-assets-staging"

# The bucket and the credentials that may write to it belong to the same
# environment, so selecting one selects the other. See fnox.toml.
FNOX_PROFILE = "staging"

VITE_BASE_PATH = "https://egr-assets-staging.object.storage.eu01.onstackit.cloud/"
VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN = "phc_rUbW5TOq15FHTu5PoKh3g4uCJNNN7MvHu2WJPUIjEpa"
VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST = "https://ph-proxy.dev.tech.digitalservice.dev"

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat mise.preview.toml; echo "==="; cat mise.staging.toml
